_comment: List prices in USD per million tokens, the one place the spend guard prices OpenClaw API turns. The first entry whose 'match' is a substring of the model id wins. Cache writes bill at cache_write_multiplier x input, cache reads at cache_read_multiplier x input. A model no entry matches is priced at 'default' (set to the dearest tier so a new model errs high) and counted in openclaw_api_spend_unpriced_tokens: add a row when that metric is above 0.
